thread:
zoe: Quick thought thread: onboarding pipeline needs clearer stages for replay depth vs cost. Current monolithic 'bench' both costs a lot and blocks promotion.

eric: Agreed. What if we split into 3 pass stages: smoke (fast token-level), staged-replay (medium sequences, partial state), and final-golden (full coverage)? Each with different budgets + retention.

sasha: We already have smoke + full, but staged-replay is new. How would we pick sequences for staged run? random vs targeted?

zoe: Proposal: staged-replay uses stratified sampling with two axes: seq_len (short/med/long) and session_type (single-turn, multi-turn, streaming). Budget: 200 sequences total, weighted toward medium seq_len for catching off-by-one KV bugs.

vivek: Important to couple staged-replay with KV-warmup semantics. If prober doesn't simulate runtime prefixing we miss cache-dependent failures. handshake flag idea: simulate_prefix: none|short|full.

ci-bot: triggered: PR 3241 added simulate_prefix flag in prober schema (preview).

eric: Nice. Another operational thing: artifact TTLs. Full-golden artifacts are big; we should keep them for 30 days by default, but smoke and staged summaries can be 7 days. Also add checksum + minimal diffs to speed triage.

sasha: For promotion gates: require smoke pass locally, staged-replay pass in bench-fleet, and at least one successful final-golden within 48h for stable. For internal experiments we can relax to 'canary' tag.

zoe: Can we make the promotion gate configurable per-catalog-entry? e.g., "experimental" models have lower bar. That avoids blocking research.

vivek: Yes, add metadata on model registration: promotion_policy: strict|canary|experimental. Default strict. Also add cost_budget field so teams know expected bench costs.

zoe: Example registration metadata snippet:

```
model_registration:
  model_id: "rwi-xlarge-v2"
  promotion_policy: "strict"
  bench_budget_usd: "50"
  default_golden_set: "golden-2026-02"
  simulate_prefix: "short"
```

ci-bot: note: bench_budget_usd is advisory; billing enforcement TBD.

eric: On sampling: keep a tiny synthetic stratum for tokenization edgecases and a code-only bucket. Those caught regressions earlier. 5% of staged samples from those strata.

sasha: Triage ergonomics 1: If staged-replay fails, prober should attach a min-diff artifact: top 5 mismatched tokens plus the input seeds. No massive logs. That speeds debugging.

vivek: Also standardize retry policy: bench jobs should be idempotent and not masked by retries. For smoke: allow 1 retry on transient infra error. For staged & golden: zero retries to preserve signal.

bench-bot: scheduled: staged-replay rwi-xlarge-v2 (200 seq) on bench-fleet 7m ETA; artifact will be posted to /bench/artifacts/1767810001. :robot_face:

eric: One more thought 1 measurement windows: track p99 latency and a "session-stability" metric (fraction of sessions with no divergence across tokens). Use that to spot flaky stateful failures.

sasha: Sounds good. Next steps: (1) update prober schema with simulate_prefix + promotion_policy + bench_budget, (2) add staged-replay job type to orchestrator, (3) docs + sample config in onboarding guide, (4) enforce TTLs in artifact store. I'll start a draft RFC.

zoe: Thanks 1 please call out cost-controls in RFC; finance will want to auto-flag models exceeding bench_budget.

vivek: I'll add a lightweight CLI subcommand so engs can run staged-replay locally with a small sample set: `rwi prober run --lane staged --samples 30 --simulate_prefix short`.

eric: +1. No blockers from me.

sasha: fine by me. I'll wait for the RFC link.

zoe: I'll open the RFC this afternoon and tag bench + prober owners. :memo:
